thread:
Marta S: Heads up — I have a 6hr layover in KEF next week. Anyone who’s done Reykjavik transit know if I should sprint for Bæjarins Beztu pylsur (hot dog stand) or just stick to a bowl of fiskisúpa (fish soup)? budget traveler + carry-on only.
Liam: go hot dog. iconic, quick, cheap. get the crunchy fried onions. :hotdog:
Noor: +1 hot dog if you want street vibes. fiskisúpa is better if it’s cold and you can sit for 20–30m.
Sanjay: if you have time, the Sun Voyager walk is short and near the bus stop — worth 15m fresh air before a flight. otherwise pylsur wins.
Marta S: perfect — hate long waits in restaurants during layover. how’s the bus from terminal?
Liam: Flybus 1 takes ~45m total but leaves every 30m. you can also take the airport shuttle into town (check schedule).
Noor: pro tip: if you only have carry-on and want to stash a small jacket, the tourist info next to Harpa has lockers for short stays.
Sanjay: if you decide fiskisúpa, try "Icelandic Fish & Chips" near Laugavegur for a quick bowl — sits are limited tho.
Marta S: love it. ok hot dog it is. any allergy/veg suggestions?
Liam: there’s a veggie sausage option at Bæjarins Beztu, but call it "not exactly" meat. also a lot of bakeries on Laugavegur have eggless pastries.
Noor: and coffee shops are everywhere — order a small flat white and you’re golden. ☕
OpsBot: Reminder: KEF layover threads are for non-work chatter. :party_parrot:
Marta S: thanks everyone — will grab a photo for the snack channel if it’s photogenic. :camera_with_flash:
Liam: pls post, hot dog aesthetics are a hill I will die on. :grimacing:
Noor: safe travels and enjoy the mini-adventure!
